title: Megurine Luka — Profile Story

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello, everyone. My name is Megurine Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm very happy to see so many of you here today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope you've been having fun so far?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I can see there are some guests from overseas as well.
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I've prepared some songs that our guests from overseas will be able to enjoy as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's time for my bilingual vocals to shine.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The concert is far from over.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We'll be singing the best we can to fire everyone up even more! I hope you're ready!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Shall we put on the next song now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hold up your glow sticks, everyone.
It's time to party!
